name: JARVIS
summary: A private executive AI on the owner's Mac: an original faceted obsidian mask with slanted magenta sensor eyes, rendered live as a 3D swarm of glowing see-through nanobots inside a reticle of rotating rings, in a dark HUD where every panel is framed by magenta corner brackets.

face_base.role: the face; particle positions and colours are sampled from it

reference_images.art_prompt: Front-facing portrait of an original artificial intelligence, no human features, no body: a sculpted mask of black obsidian and dark gunmetal armour plates with sharp angular facets and a central vertical crest, perfectly symmetrical, narrow slanted glowing hot-pink magenta sensor eyes with white-hot cores, thin glowing magenta light lines tracing the brow and cheek plates, emerging from pure black darkness, magenta rim light, faint volumetric haze, cinematic, ultra-detailed photoreal 3D render, centred, pure black background, no text, no logo.
reference_images.art_negative: human skin, mouth, cartoon, toy robot, text, watermark, helmet straps, background objects
reference_images.originality: Original character. Do not name, copy or imitate Ultron, Ultraman, Vision or any other existing character.

typography.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
typography.label: 13px, sentence case (no all-caps labels)

shape.panels: faint magenta-to-black fill, hairline border, 14px bright magenta corner brackets on all four corners
shape.headings: followed by a thin magenta rule fading to the right
shape.active_nav: 2px magenta left edge with a fading magenta wash
shape.room: near-black with a faint 44px scan grid and soft magenta light behind the face

face.renderer: WebGL (no library), Canvas 2D fallback, vector SVG face if no image

particles.source: sampled from base.png, weighted by brightness with a floor so dark plates still get bots

face.look: soft round sprites with additive light (see-through), a large dim bloom pass, depth fog, twinkle

rings.behaviour: real 3D circles of bots spinning in their own planes, broken into arcs

face.camera: turns toward the cursor (gaze), slow idle sway; perspective 2.6

motion_rules.principle: Motion only with a cause. Nothing splits apart for show.
motion_rules.first_load: built from the rings, layer by layer, bottom to top (2.6 s)
motion_rules.thinking: a build line runs up the face and re-places a thin band; the face stays whole
motion_rules.executing: a scan line sweeps down (1.8 s)
motion_rules.failure: one side breaks off, then is rebuilt by the build line
motion_rules.voice: ripples across the surface with the speech or microphone level
motion_rules.cursor: parts the bots like a hand through smoke
motion_rules.click: sends a ripple from the click point

emotion.sad: blue, dim, sinks and holds together

concerned.label: CONCERNED
concerned.line: A step failed. I'm isolating the cause.

awaiting.label: AWAITING YOU
awaiting.line: One decision is needed before I proceed.

success.label: COMPLETED
success.line: Completed. The result has been verified.

failure.label: FAILED
failure.line: I have not marked this as complete.

voice.speech_in: whisper.cpp ggml-small.en with a vocabulary hint
voice.style: spoken replies: one to three short sentences, plain words; long answers say three sentences and leave the rest on screen
voice.interrupt: say 'Jarvis' to cut it off; click the face to mute until called again

character: Calm, precise executive intelligence. Leads with the answer, challenges weak ideas respectfully, never claims what it did not do.
